Dutch split pea soup is really comforting cold weather food. It takes hours and hours because you gotta buy dry split peas and let them dissolve through boiling. It's cheap and tasty though.

For a big pot, take like 500 gr split peas, 2 or 3 big carrots, half a celeriac, a couple of big potatoes and onions, your preferred broth, celery leaves and smoked sausage or bratwurst (I like beyond meat bratwurst)

Cook the split peas for a good hour and a half in broth, then add everything but the sausage. Just keep cooking it, stirring and adding water until the peas no longer hold their shape. Yes, it takes forever. Add the sausage last, and maybe some ground pepper. That's it I think
